notes: projectType: auto | foundry | hardhat (auto-detects foundry.toml vs hardhat.config.*). Hardhat v2 AND v3 are supported (v3 needs crytic-compile >= 0.4) - see the runtime support matrix printed by `fuzzpipe doctor` (the single source of truth). mode: auto | guided | targeted. standards: any of ERC20/721/4626/7540 the protocol implements to auto-pull ToB library invariants. `fuzzpipe run` auto-generates the per-engine medusa.json/echidna.yaml; this file is the higher-level intent. budgets are per-tier wall-clock seconds (--budget overrides tier1). fuzzing.workers = Medusa internal goroutine count (--workers overrides). parallel.enabled = run per-invariant medusa shards + echidna concurrently in Tier-1 (--jobs sets the pool, --no-parallel disables). tier2 (halmos) is eval-gated: set FUZZPIPE_SYMBOLIC=1.
